Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit IMAGE 1, one existing transparent game sprite animation frame run/SW/13. IMAGE 2 is neighbouring SW/08, ONLY a reference for boot heading toward screen-lower-left, never its pose. IMAGE 3 is the primary approved clean Q-style hand-painted finish reference, not a scene to copy.
Make ONE small anatomy correction to IMAGE 1: the trailing rear leg on SCREEN RIGHT ends in a boot whose toe points outward toward screen-right/down. Correct ONLY this screen-right trailing lower shin/ankle and boot orientation. Preserve the long extended backward leg, bent knee, foot location and toe-off phase; rotate the boot's heading so the toe projects LEFT of the ankle center and points toward screen-LOWER-LEFT, parallel to the southwest travel direction. The trailing boot is a smaller far boot; keep it smaller than the near front boot. Give the toe-off ankle coherent plantar flexion without rolling the sole sideways; the gold-edged toe should press/push straight in the travel plane. Keep the FRONT boot at lower-left unchanged, do not swap legs and do not tuck the extended trailing leg. Keep its crescent emblem, navy leather, gold bands and bow coherent with this new view.
LOCK everything outside that trailing ankle/boot correction to IMAGE 1: full original square composition, head/body scale and position, face, purple eyes, lavender bob and cowlick, left-temple ornament, lean, scarf, robe, belt, beads, both arms and exactly two hands each holding exactly one existing crescent dagger. No head movement, no camera change, no recentering, mirroring or zoom. One full single sprite, native high-resolution square PNG preferably1254x1254 or at least1024x1024, genuine transparent RGBA background. No floor, shadow, text, sheet, UI or extra effects. Keep original polished rounded Q-version game artwork. Only fix the outward rear-foot yaw.
